author: sereus.org

sections.text: In the case of a dispute between the Parties over any associated transaction that is resolved by legal remedy, the prevailing Party shall be entitled to collect actual damages incurred from the losing Party, plus all collection costs, including attorneys' fees.
sections.title: Damages

sections.text: Should any cause of action brought by one Party against the other be shown to be frivolous, or without basis, the penalty shall be increased to two times the actual damages incurred, plus all collection costs, including attorneys' fees.
sections.title: Frivolous Claims

sections.text: When intentional fraud can be proven in a dispute between the Parties, the penalty shall be increased to three times the actual damages incurred, plus all collection costs, including attorneys' fees.
sections.title: Fraud

text: A dispute between the Parties under this Agreement that the Parties cannot resolve between themselves may be brought by either Party before any court of competent jurisdiction.
title: Resolution of Disputes by Legal Remedy
